phase: Phase 1: Page B in the preview folder (by Wed 2026-11-18)
summary: Round 5 passes with no blocker. The publish gate holds in my own probes on git archive copies of 2a9d421. A docs root symlink cannot redirect a write (ADV-1). A record without approved_by or date cannot publish; six bypass variants each exit 2 with one line (ADV-2, spec D21 consent gate). The staged publish leaves no partial set and no .publish-*.tmp file, and the drift walk refuses planted temp names before staging, so temp names cannot be redirected (ADV-11). No unknown coverage key reaches the public real-work.json (ADV-7). The docs scan refuses a FIFO, a socket, and a directory link before any write. No real export byte or SHA entered the repo beyond the three track documents that held them at phase base. Round-4 Nit B4-1 is withdrawn: the staged rename unlinks a docs hard link and the outside file stays byte-identical. Three Nits remain: a header order line, the carried same-user race window (B4-2 narrowed), and a FIFO in the preview folder that stalls preview.sh.
security_applicability: applicable: test-strategy.md section 9 Phase 1 row assigns Review B the publish gate, the no-docs/-write rule, and the no-real-export-bytes rule. git diff --name-only 0acceea..2a9d421 lists harness/model-guide/publish.ts, harness/model-guide/preview.sh, and harness/model-guide/real-work.ts, which hold that gate, plus two test files and plan.md.
nonblocking_findings: B5-1 [Nit] review-b: harness/model-guide/real-work.ts:8-9 documents the check order as `input, json, manifest, sha256, size, schema, run-sum`, but the code runs the manifest read at :239-241, the sha256 check at :243-247, and the size check at :248-251 before the JSON parse at :254-259. A single-fault input prints the right name (probe p7: bad JSON gives `input-check: json`, exit 2, empty stderr, no output folder). A multi-fault input (bad JSON plus a wrong manifest) prints `sha256` where the header order says `json`. The tool fails closed in every case. Fix: align the header line with the code order.

B5-2 [Nit] review-b: carried from B4-2 with a narrower scope. A same-user race window remains between scan and write: preview.sh scans docs at :112-183 and copies at :185-189; publish.ts walks docs at :197-223 and stages at :237-248. The staged design closes the destination-name write-through: rename does not follow a link at the destination, and the drift walk refuses any planted entry before staging (probe p4: three planted .publish-* names each give one drift line, exit 2, secrets byte-identical). The residual window is a temp name swapped to a symlink between the walk and writeFileSync at publish.ts:242, in milliseconds, same user only. Not closable with a path check; record only. Optional hardening: pass the flag `wx` to writeFileSync so an existing temp name fails.

B5-3 [Nit] review-b: harness/model-guide/preview.sh:99-105 scans an existing preview folder with `find -type l`, so it refuses symlinks only. Probe p10: a FIFO planted at <preview>/real-work.json stalls the run; timeout ended it after 30 s with no refusal line, because cp at preview.sh:189 blocks on the FIFO. The docs scan refuses every non-regular entry (probe p6: FIFO, socket, and directory link each give `preview: refused path <abs>`, exit 2, no .tmp folder). The boundary is the user-owned .tmp folder, so the case is same-user only. Fix: refuse non-regular entries in the preview folder too, or write page files to temp names and rename.

ADV-1 (probe p1): docs replaced by a symlink to an outside folder, with a valid approval record and preview. Publish exited 2 with the single line `publish: bad docs root` and empty stderr. The link target held only its sentinel file, byte-identical. publish.ts:191-196 lstats the root before the drift walk and the copy.

ADV-2 and A2 (probe p2): record variants with no owner line, a commented `# approved_by:` line, a blank owner value, a wrong-case `Approved_by:`, a blank date, and a missing date line each gave exit 2, the single line `publish: bad approval record`, empty stderr, and an unchanged docs snapshot. The control record (approved_by plus date plus two rows) published exactly the two approved files with matching shas; no other docs file changed; `find docs -name '.publish-*.tmp'` was empty. The real tree holds no publish-approval.md (ls of measure/tracks/model_guide), so the consent gate of spec D21 (spec.md:772) is closed, and the public page names no subject: the live real-work.html holds 0 matches for daniel, daniebo, school, teacher, and student.

ADV-11 partial set (probe p3): two approved rows, the second under a mode-0555 docs/locked folder. Publish exited 2 with the single line `publish: write locked/new.html` and empty stderr. docs/real-work.json did not exist after the run (no partial set), 0 temp files remained under docs, and the docs snapshot was unchanged. publish.ts:227-248 stages every file, drops all staged temp files on a failure, and renames only after every stage succeeded.

ADV-11 temp-name redirect (probe p4): a symlink .publish-777-0.tmp at the docs root, a regular file .publish-888-1.tmp, and a symlink sub/.publish-999-0.tmp beneath an approved new folder each landed in the drift walk of publish.ts:122-150 before staging. Publish exited 2 with exactly three sorted `publish: drift` lines naming the planted entries. Both outside secrets stayed S0; the planted regular file kept its content; docs gained nothing. A planted temp name therefore cannot redirect a stage write.

Preview docs scan (probe p6): a FIFO, a unix socket, and a directory symlink under docs each gave exit 2, one line `preview: refused path <absolute path>`, empty stderr, and no .tmp folder; no run hung (timeout 60). The control run gave exit 0 and built the preview folder. The Python scan at preview.sh:112-183 lstats every entry, refuses any symlink or other non-regular entry, reports unreadable entries, and runs before mkdir and cp.

The real preview.sh exited 0 and the public real-work.json held 0 occurrences of the key and of the needle; real-work.html held 0.
